title: Robin Accuracy and GPU Deployment
caption: Robin combined MSE and batch-4 cost for identical saved model identities. Per-fit costs use the median of three block medians, then family centers average the individual seed values. Diamonds are family centers; hollow seed markers and three block points/ranges retain measured variation. Spans are not confidence intervals. Logarithmic cost axes display all approved models, including fast small linear alternatives, without cropping unfavorable errors. GPU deployment starts with standardized CPU input and returns full CPU output. Allocated memory is distinct from reserved/process memory and deployed tensor bytes. F0 post sentinels are retained in source data but excluded from family centers. The figure does not infer stable speed superiority from point centers or compare historical timing.

drift_checks.interpretation: Descriptive drift/rank checks only; no automatic correction, deletion, repetition or causal attribution.

cost_summary.definition: Per fit: median of three block medians; group center: arithmetic mean of individual fit medians. F0 post excluded. Within-block raw 20-pass IQR remains in rows. No independent-sample confidence interval.

measurement_contract.scope: Standardized FP32 CPU input -> complete CPU [B,48,17] output; synchronized wall for GPU.

calculations.mse: Stored combined loss, mean of model losses; no ensemble or target rescore.
calculations.cost: Per fit median of three block medians, then mean over role members.
calculations.memory: MiB = bytes / 1024**2; CPU has no GPU-memory value.

figure_text: Peak allocated GPU memory (MiB; log scale)

Diamond: mean seed loss and mean per-seed median block cost.
Hollow: individual seed; small points / spans: three block medians / range.
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070. Sentinel IQRs disjoint: 0/6; pair order reversals: 65.
